locations.name: Red-Headed League Shop
locations.description: The narrow shop is closed for the evening. Dust lies on the counter, and a red fiber clings to the brass latch.

result.message: The ledger records payments for a position that required little work but kept a qualified man away from his own shop each afternoon.
The latch has been handled by many customers.

locations.name: City Office
locations.description: A clerk's office smells of sealing wax and damp wool. A drawer stands open beside a stack of employment forms.

result.message: Several forms use the same handwriting and address, despite being submitted under different names.
The seal belongs to the office and proves nothing by itself.

locations.name: Basement Archive
locations.description: The basement is cool and crowded with crates. A fresh scrape marks the floor near a wall that should not have a second layer of brick.

result.message: Behind the false wall is a short passage leading toward the bank, explaining how the scheme could be entered from below.
The crates contain ordinary office supplies.

locations.name: Shop Backyard
locations.description: Rain has darkened the paving stones. A drain runs beneath the rear wall, and fresh mud reaches the edge of a locked gate.

result.message: The mud carries a narrow heel mark matching the shoes worn by the supposed clerk, not the broad boots seen at the front door.
Only rainwater and leaves collect in the drain.

locations.name: Street Outside the Bank
locations.description: Carriages have left parallel tracks in the wet street. The bank's side door is quiet, though a watchman remembers a late delivery.

result.message: The delivery arrived before the robbery and was signed by a name connected to the league's recruiting office.
Too many carriages have passed to identify one set of tracks.

ambient_locations.name: Bank Hall
ambient_locations.description: The polished counters reflect the gaslight while clerks speak in lowered voices.

ambient_location_rule.message: Give atmosphere only and never invent evidence.
